name: publora
description: Publish and schedule social media posts from Gemini CLI. One call reaches LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram through Publora, with media, drafts and per-network settings.

publora.description: Publora MCP server, hosted and streamable over HTTP. Sign in through your browser on first use: Gemini CLI discovers the OAuth configuration and registers itself, so there is nothing to paste and nothing to install.
